feedback_note: Our founding collection starts with participation, court style, and women’s communities. These are selected background reads, not a claim that every story is new today. Your reviews will shape the first AI-researched edition.

stories.title: Women are shaping pickleball’s next chapter
stories.summary: SFIA’s 2026 participation report says women account for 42.9% of pickleball players, up from 38.6% in 2020. Its release offers a useful starting point for understanding who is coming to the court.
stories.why: A women-focused publication should start by understanding the people who play.
stories.title_zh: 女性正在塑造匹克球的新篇章
stories.summary_zh: SFIA 的 2026 年参与度报告指出，女性占匹克球参与者的 42.9%，高于 2020 年的 38.6%。这份发布稿为了解走上球场的人群提供了一个起点。
stories.why_zh: 面向女性的内容，应先了解参与这项运动的人。

stories.title: A courtside lookbook with personality
stories.summary: Pickleball.com’s September fashion edit highlights outfits worn at the Veolia Pickleball National Championships. Browse it as a visual starting point for your own court style.
stories.why: Tell us whether you prefer professional-player inspiration or practical, affordable outfit ideas.
stories.title_zh: 有个性的球场穿搭灵感
stories.summary_zh: Pickleball.com 的九月穿搭精选展示了 Veolia 匹克球全国锦标赛上的球员服装。不妨把它作为寻找个人球场风格的灵感来源。
stories.why_zh: 告诉我们：你更喜欢职业球员的穿搭灵感，还是实用、平价的搭配建议？

stories.title: Follow the women building a wider pickleball community
stories.summary: The National Women’s Pickleball Foundation’s press archive brings together its community initiatives and announcements. It is a source to follow as we look for welcoming stories beyond tournament results.
stories.why: Community organizations can lead us to people and projects worth covering in depth.
stories.title_zh: 关注拓展女性匹克球社群的人
stories.summary_zh: 美国国家女子匹克球基金会的新闻档案汇集了社群项目与机构公告。这是我们寻找赛果之外、更加友好且贴近人的故事的线索来源。
stories.why_zh: 社群组织能帮助我们发现值得深入了解的人物和项目。

stories.title: Keep an official source in the mix
stories.summary: USA Pickleball’s news hub collects governing-body updates, events, and community announcements. We will use official sources alongside independent stories to ground the daily edit.
stories.why: Interesting stories need reliable context as well as a good headline.
stories.title_zh: 让官方信息成为阅读的一部分
stories.summary_zh: USA Pickleball 的新闻页面汇集了管理机构动态、活动与社群公告。我们会结合官方来源和独立报道，为每日精选提供背景。
stories.why_zh: 好故事除了吸引人的标题，还需要可靠的背景信息。

stories.title: From one community event to a weekend habit
stories.title_zh: 从一场社区比赛，走进每个周末
stories.summary: A report published on China’s General Administration of Sport website describes strong interest in a Guiyang community pickleball event. Its focus is on making the sport part of everyday community life.
stories.summary_zh: 国家体育总局网站的一篇报道介绍了贵阳社区匹克球活动的报名热度，并将视角放在这项运动如何走进普通人的日常生活。
stories.why: A Chinese-language perspective on how local play can build lasting participation.
stories.why_zh: 从中文报道中，观察身边的球场如何带动持续参与。
stories.source: 国家体育总局 · General Administration of Sport of China

feedback_note_zh: 创刊精选从参与人群、球场穿搭和女性社群开始。这些是有来源链接的背景读物，并非今日新闻。你的评分与建议将帮助我们准备第一期 AI 研究精选。
